name: OpenVibe.Services
description: OpenVibe.Services is the way into everything programmable on OpenVibe: projects, apps, keys, grants and usage over Network's developer API; generated API, contract, SDK, capability and event docs; OAuth and webhook tools; playgrounds; app and mod releases; and one resource index over every service, with each service keeping its own data. Next: start from what you want to build and it assembles the services, keys, permissions and working code for you.

pillars.title: Discover
pillars.text: Every service, capability, contract and event, with generated API references.

pillars.title: Build
pillars.text: Projects, apps, keys, grants, playgrounds, OAuth and webhook tools, starter code.

pillars.title: Ship
pillars.text: App and mod manifests, releases and trust tiers, with a public page per app.

pillars.title: Operate
pillars.text: Usage, quotas, exports and one resource index over the whole network.

keywords: openvibe services, developer platform, open source backend, api platform, event bus api, ai gateway, website monitoring api, developer console
launch: the developer console and docs (moved from openvibe.codes) and the merged resource index
